'''Rene Hidalgo''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[February 2000 Boca Raton tournament]] on 6 February 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP objective deck]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d227">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-06-d-d-d-d-d-dengar-boca-fl-2-6-00d227/ d-d-d-d-d-dengar-boca-fl-2-6-00], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 6 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-06-d-d-d-d-d-dengar-boca-fl-2-6-00d227/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
